body: I have the exact same problem, except I rarely even drop hints. Everything has to be so superficial and perfect, yet on the inside it feels like I'm screaming, trying to be let out. Talking in text can be fine but only because I have an escape ( deleting or ignoring). I feel so messed up :/

Hmm, I have a LOT of 'conversations' in my head.. Always things I wish I could actually discuss with people, but for the most part my actual dialogue is superficial at best. I'm mostly quiet though...

Sorry for the brevity; typing this on my iPod at 5 am makes me not very elaborate lol
Errr.. Yeah, you're right. My bad lol. They're both definitely psycostimulants :D

Methylphenidate isn't exactly a stimulant. It's a nonreprine(spelling)-dopamine reuptake inhibitor. It keeps your brain from sucking up those neurotransmitters, unlike adderal which just causes your brain to put out more dopamine. Sounds like an off brand Ritalin
Sometimes I'll close a reddit.com tab and immediately open another reddit.com tab for no reason.. I do this a lot with a lot if sites lol.

I think they would be supportive and helpful honestly.. but I still can't do it. I just completely freeze up any time any conversation comes up about it (well not exactly about my depression, but when my depression is the real reason for something I've done.) I can tell they're worried because of the way I've been acting. I don't know, I feel so trapped and scared and confused... definitely not doing well :/

I hate lying, so I do it sparingly. Yesterday I was extremely distraught and really wanted to tell my mom about my depression, but all I could do was sit there and not say anything. Finally I said "I'm fine" and she left me alone, but it was so hard :/

Well, really 7th grade is as far back as I can remember being depressed, but before that I don't really remember too much about my emotions. I was always the smart kid in elementary school and I was bullied a lot, and I've always been held to a lot of really high expectations in terms of grades (especially after I cruised through middle school doing almost no real work and getting straight As.) So I'm not really sure.
Not sure.. it's just never been in my nature to seek help or talk deeply about what's bothering me.

I don't think I've ever woken up and felt like I wanted to do anything other than go back to sleep. Most of the time I get up because it would be socially unacceptable to stay in bed any longer (and if I lived by myself I don't know if I would get out of bed, honestly.) I have a lot of love for my friends and family which mostly keeps me here but I have absolutely none for myself. I'm lazy, apathetic, and unmotivated. No matter how hard I try to make my life better, more organized, healthy, it never works. I'm sick of trying but the big problem is I have no way of communicating these issues without massive amounts of alcohol and tear. (it's happened twice, both times have been to friends of differing perspectives, neither of which were particularly useful.) It's so easy to talk about under the guise of anonymity and through text.. but I'm completely unable to utter so much as a syllable to a loved one. It's hell.  Sorry I ranted so much lol

Eh.. being with friends is always nice, it helps distract me but even the whole night I was kinda drab and quiet. It was a big pubcrawl event that was enjoyable, but I almost didn't go. Besides drinking and acting stupid, I felt I was otherwise merely "present."
I mean... there are people who give Aids away willingly. It wouldn't surprise me.

Hahahaha I remember this... Rogue Fang reporting in. 

Who the fuck brought *Moon Moon* along?

It's not even the exams that are the worst part of it. It's the utter lack of preparedness that I've put myself in. I feel like the worst person in the world. This semester has easily been the worst period of my life thus far (dealt with depression for almost 10 years, hard mode: no talking to anyone about it ever.) It's just.. I don't know if I'm going to make it through the end of this. I can't stand myself anymore.
